1.w: One dead fly makes the perfumer’s ointment give off a rancid stench, so a little folly can outweigh much wisdom.

2.w: A wise person’s good sense protects him, but a fool’s lack of sense leaves him vulnerable.

3.w: Even when a fool walks along the road he lacks sense and shows everyone what a fool he is.

4.w: If the anger of the ruler flares up against you, do not resign from your position, for a calm response can undo great offenses.

5.w: I have seen another misfortune on the earth: It is an error a ruler makes.

6.w: Fools are placed in many positions of authority, while wealthy men sit in lowly positions.

7.w: I have seen slaves on horseback and princes walking on foot like slaves.

8.w: One who digs a pit may fall into it, and one who breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.

9.w: One who quarries stones may be injured by them; one who splits logs may be endangered by them.

10.w: If an iron axhead is blunt and a workman does not sharpen its edge, he must exert a great deal of effort; so wisdom has the advantage of giving success.

11.w: If the snake should bite before it is charmed, the snake charmer is in trouble.

12.w: The words of a wise person win him favor, but the words of a fool are self-destructive.

13.w: At the beginning his words are foolish and at the end his talk is wicked madness,

14.w: yet a fool keeps on babbling. No one knows what will happen; who can tell him what will happen in the future?

15.w: The toil of a stupid fool wears him out, because he does not even know the way to the city.

16.w: Woe to you, O land, when your king is childish and your princes feast in the morning.

17.w: Blessed are you, O land, when your king is the son of nobility, and your princes feast at the proper time —with self-control and not in drunkenness.

18.w: Because of laziness the roof caves in, and because of idle hands the house leaks.

19.w: Feasts are made for laughter, and wine makes life merry, but money is the answer for everything.

20.w: Do not curse a king even in your thoughts, and do not curse the rich while in your bedroom; for a bird might report what you are thinking, or some winged creature might repeat your words.
